The '''''Ephin Sarreti''''' was a [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] in service to the [[Fel Empire]]. Part of the [[Second Outer Rim Fleet]], [[Rulf Yage]] served aboard the vessel, coordinating starfighter tactics for the entire fleet.

==Description==
The ''Ephin Sarreti'' was a [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] that served the [[Fel Empire]] over a hundred [[Standard year/Legends|years]] after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]]. It carried a number of [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]] aboard.<ref name="LECG" />

==History==
The ''Ephin Sarreti'' was assigned to the [[Second Outer Rim Fleet]]. At some point, [[Rulf Yage]]&mdash;a former [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] with [[1st Imperial Center Core Defense Squadron|Skull Squadron]] and later a [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]]&mdash;served aboard the [[Starship/Legends|vessel]]. His primary duty was coordinating starfighter tactics and deployment for the entire [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]].<ref name="LECG" />

==Behind the scenes==
The ''Ephin Sarreti'' received its only mention in the ''[[Legacy Era Campaign Guide]]'', published in [[2009]], where it was established in Rulf Yage's biography that he had served aboard the vessel.
